source_files.features/application/project-dialog/proj:
@application @projects
Feature: Inspect the project dialog
  The MCAD Software provides project information from the new-document chooser.

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Inspect project information from the template chooser
    Given the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
    And a project is active
    And a template is selected with its details displayed
    When the user chooses Projects in the chooser
    Then a Projects dialog opens above the chooser
    And the dialog lists project names and locations
    And the active project is marked
    And the dialog displays a project settings tree
    And New, Browse, Save, Apply and Done controls are displayed
    When the user chooses Done without changing the project
    Then the Projects dialog closes
    And the template chooser is displayed again
    And the selected template details remain displayed

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Inspect an inactive project without activating it
    Given the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
    And the Projects dialog lists an active project and another project
    And the active project is marked in the list
    When the user selects the other project with a single click
    Then the other project row is highlighted
    And the settings tree displays information for the selected project
    And the active-project mark remains beside the original project
    When the user chooses Done
    Then the Projects dialog closes
    And the chooser still displays the original active project

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Inspect and cancels the new single-user project wizard
    Given the Projects dialog is open in the MCAD Software
    And an existing project is active
    And the wizard fixture has no entries in either library list
    When the user chooses New
    Then the new-project wizard opens on a project-type page
    And New Single User Project is selected
    And the Next and cancels controls are available
    When the user chooses Next
    Then the wizard displays a project name, workspace folder and project file to be created
    And it provides a folder browsing control
    When the user chooses Next
    Then the wizard displays a Select Libraries page
    And the page has All Projects and New Project lists with transfer controls
    And both library lists are empty
    And a provisional project entry is visible in the project list behind the wizard
    When the user chooses Cancel
    Then the wizard closes and the Projects dialog is displayed
    And the provisional project entry is no longer listed
    And the original project remains marked active

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Navigate backward through the new-project wizard
    Given the new single-user project wizard is on its project-type page in the MCAD Software
    When the user chooses Next
    Then the project-file page displays the project name and workspace folder
    When the user chooses Next
    Then the Select Libraries page is displayed
    When the user chooses Back
    Then the project-file page is displayed
    And its project name and workspace folder remain displayed
    When the user chooses Back
    Then the project-type page is displayed
    And New Single User Project remains selected
    And Back and Finish are unavailable
    When the user chooses Cancel
    Then the wizard closes and the Projects dialog is displayed

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Cancel browsing for a project workspace folder
    Given the new single-user project wizard is on its project-file page in the MCAD Software
    And a workspace folder and project file location are displayed
    When the user chooses the workspace folder browse control
    Then a folder browser opens with a folder tree and a Folder field
    And it offers Make New Folder, OK and cancels
    When the user selects Documents in the folder tree
    Then Documents is selected and its child folders are displayed
    And the Folder field displays Documents
    When the user chooses Cancel in the folder browser
    Then the folder browser closes
    And the wizard still displays the previous workspace folder and project file location
    When the user cancels the project wizard
    Then the Projects dialog is displayed

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Choose the workspace folder for a new project
    Given the new single-user project wizard is on its project-file page in the MCAD Software
    And the project has a displayed name
    When the user chooses the workspace folder browse control
    And the user selects the Documents folder
    And the user chooses OK in the folder browser
    Then the wizard displays Documents as the workspace folder
    And the displayed project file location is inside Documents and uses the displayed project name
    When the user cancels the project wizard
    Then the Projects dialog is displayed
    And the original project remains marked active

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Expand and collapse project settings with the keyboard
    Given the Projects dialog is open in the MCAD Software
    And an active project with Folder Options and Options groups is displayed
    When the user selects the collapsed Folder Options group
    And the user presses the Right Arrow key
    Then the group expands to show folder entries including Templates, Design Data and Presets
    When the user presses the Left Arrow key
    Then the Folder Options children are hidden
    When the user selects the collapsed Options group
    And the user presses the Right Arrow key
    Then the group expands to show project options including old versions to keep and unique file names
    And the active project remains marked in the project list

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Expand library groups independently in the project tree
    Given the Projects dialog is open in the MCAD Software
    And the selected project has collapsed Appearance Libraries and Material Libraries groups with entries
    When the user selects Appearance Libraries and presses the Right Arrow key
    Then the appearance library entries are visible beneath their group
    When the user selects Material Libraries and presses the Right Arrow key
    Then the material library entries are visible beneath their group
    And the appearance library entries remain visible
    When the user presses the Left Arrow key
    Then the material library entries are hidden
    And the appearance library entries remain visible
    And the active project remains marked in the project list
